purpose: Active ESP32-S3 controller baseline plus historical Rev A assembly/wire coverage. Original 142 connections are legacy nRF52840/physical-aircraft references, not ESP32 wiring or an executable scenario.

execution_order: C0-C7: physical hand-controller prototype and computer bridge
D1-D4: Simantic drone MCU/hardware -> actuator outputs -> mechanics -> screen, with sensor feedback
current_scope.legacy_field_semantics: All original assemblies, components, pins, power_domains, connection IDs and required_validation lists describe historical Rev A, including superseded nRF52840 hand/hub wiring. active_controller defines the new baseline; consult its linked guides before purchases or assembly.

path_convention: All source paths are relative to repository root.

simulation_status.assembly_models: ESP32-S3 qualification underway; STM32H743 diagnostic and stock-boot evidence exists; see capability-audit group reports
simulation_status.application_firmware: see current firmware plan; MCU simulation does not establish implementation or physical qualification

model_candidates.verified_scope: see capability-audit/esp32s3; catalog inclusion does not qualify ADC/I2C/BLE or full firmware

Diagnostic MCU/bus/PWM evidence plus stock ArduCopter IMU FIFO transactions and vehicle-loop execution with explicit fixtures. Four alternate main PWM routes pass diagnostically; estimator health, flight-firmware motor control and closed feedback remain unqualified. See capability-audit/full-drone.
earlier diagnostic results retained under capability-audit/nrf52 and transport; not ESP32 evidence

power_domains.supply: Pocket own pair of radio-compatible 18650 cells
power_domains.ground: radio ground joins H_GND only at trainer sleeve
per selected bench test; do not collapse wearable domains implicitly

slot_mapping.TR6: heartbeat: 1000 / 2000, advance every two freshly generated frames with fresh both-hand data

trainer.lifecycle: Finite frame generation, independent watchdog, no indefinitely replayed DMA frames
trainer.authority: SE held AND trainer present AND TR5 valid AND recent heartbeat change AND no latched fault; deliberate release/re-enable after fault
trainer.electrical_gate: Keep physical JP301 open until actual Pocket input compatibility has been established
trainer.current_applicability: Optional legacy experiment only; not a required controller interface or completion gate.

aircraft.firmware_target: ArduCopter KakuteH7, received hardware/firmware support verification required
aircraft.motor_control: M1-M4 DShot configuration to be validated
aircraft.current_applicability: Historical hardware/firmware candidate; exact Simantic target/peripheral support unverified. No physical purchase/build requirement.

controller_host.transport: USB-to-UART bench path for ESP32 DevKit; production host transport and modeled UART adapter require qualification
controller_host.semantics: Freeze gesture mapping, serialization, timing and throttle interpretation in S3; measure actual physical transport in C6.
controller_host.authority: Host explicit start/stop/reset; invalid required hand or stale record inhibits commands. Fresh data and deliberate recovery required; held enable alone cannot restart/arm virtual drone.
